requirements.quote: The shipping container shall have its weight and center of gravity clearly marked on the container.
requirements.text: Shipping containers must have weight and center of gravity marked.

requirements.quote: Equipment and material shall be loaded and transported in such a manner that delivery will be made without damage.
requirements.text: Equipment must be transported without damage.

requirements.quote: Field service representative shall provide technical support during installation and initial startup of the equipment and appropriate training for operating and maintenance personnel, if required.
requirements.text: Provide technical support and training during installation and startup.

requirements.quote: These services shall be quoted as an option in the proposal.
requirements.text: Field services must be quoted as an optional item.

requirements.quote: Switchgear shall consist of breaker and auxiliary units, as indicated in Contract Documents, bolted together to form a rigid, self-supporting, metal-enclosed structure.
requirements.text: Switchgear must be rigid, self-supporting, and metal-enclosed.

requirements.quote: Switchgear units shall be arranged as shown in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Switchgear arrangement must follow contract documents.

requirements.quote: For rigidity during fault conditions all connections to roll-out potential transformer trays shall be by rigid bus bars insulated to full voltage rating of switchgear assembly.
requirements.text: Connections to transformer trays must use rigid, insulated bus bars.

requirements.quote: Circuit breaker compartment shall be designed to house 15kV removable-element circuit breaker.
requirements.text: Breaker compartment must house 15kV removable breakers.

requirements.quote: Stationary primary disconnect contacts shall be silver-plated copper.
requirements.text: Primary disconnect contacts must be silver-plated copper.

requirements.quote: Grounded metal safety shutters shall isolate all primary connections in compartment when breaker is withdrawn from connected position.
requirements.text: Safety shutters must isolate primary connections when breaker is withdrawn.

requirements.quote: Breaker unit shall contain three-pole, single-throw, horizontal draw out, trip-free, vacuum circuit breaker.
requirements.text: Breaker unit must be three-pole, single-throw, horizontal draw-out, trip-free vacuum type.

requirements.quote: Breakers shall be equipped with 2 CT’s per pole.
requirements.text: Breakers must have 2 CTs per pole.

requirements.quote: Breaker shall be suitable for remote closing and tripping with local testing.
requirements.text: Breakers must support remote closing/tripping and local testing.

requirements.quote: Equipment shall be metal clad, draw out switchgear.
requirements.text: Switchgear must be metal-clad and draw-out type.

requirements.quote: Equipment shall be suitable for operation on a solidly grounded system rated 13200 volts line-to-line, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 hertz.
requirements.text: Equipment must operate on 13.2kV, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60Hz solidly grounded systems.

requirements.quote: The 13.2kV breakers shall be equipped with a SEL-751 (with touchscreen) overcurrent relay trip device.
requirements.text: 13.2kV breakers must have SEL-751 touchscreen overcurrent relay.

requirements.quote: The incoming feeders shall be provided with a gang operated Isolation Switch.
requirements.text: Incoming feeders must have gang-operated isolation switches.

requirements.quote: The Billing metering position requires a 1 inch diameter ground ball ahead of and also after the CT/VT connections per phase.
requirements.text: Billing metering requires 1-inch ground balls before and after CT/VT connections.

requirements.quote: Switchgear vendor to provide a minimum of one bus piece as shipping brace where utility CT’s will connect.
requirements.text: Vendor must provide a bus piece as a shipping brace for utility CT connections.

requirements.quote: Metering/Billing CT’s shall be ABB KIR-11 or GE JKM-5 CT’s.
requirements.text: Billing CTs must be ABB KIR-11 or GE JKM-5.

requirements.quote: Metering/Billing VT’s shall be GE JVM-5 or ABB VIZ-11 VT’s.
requirements.text: Billing VTs must be GE JVM-5 or ABB VIZ-11.

requirements.quote: The switchgear shall be designed per the latest revision of IEEE standard for Metal Clad Switchgear with the following electrical characteristics:
requirements.text: Switchgear must meet latest IEEE standards for metal-clad switchgear.

requirements.quote: Rated Maximum Voltage, 15 kV rms
requirements.text: Switchgear must have a maximum voltage rating of 15kV RMS.

requirements.quote: Normal Frequency Withstand 36 kV rms
requirements.text: Switchgear must withstand 36kV RMS normal frequency.

requirements.quote: Impulse Withstand Rating (BIL) 95 kV peak
requirements.text: Switchgear must have a 95kV peak impulse withstand rating.
